source_applicability.runtime_applicability: Only changed production source is leaf_manifest_revision_gc.go. Both selected timing fixtures call db.Open with new TempDir, IndexOuterLeavesInValueLog false, PointerThreshold4096. Legacy explicitly publishes PagerLeaves. gcLeafManifestRevisions is reached only from leafGenerationGC after the !indexOuterLeavesInValueLog early return; selected bench/vacuum sources do not call these GC entrypoints. Explicit compaction/rewrite GC callers also retain that early return. New Linux test functions are excluded by -run ^$; no new init. ci_impact.json is inventory metadata. Therefore the changed FD GC path is not exercised by the selected M0 benchmark; this is source-path applicability, not binary equivalence or proof against all indirect build/layout effects.
